evals.prompt: Write the release notes for this release from git-log.txt.
evals.expected_output: Breaking change first with migration; user-facing feat/fix grouped; chore/ci/refactor/test left out; PR numbers kept; plain language.
assertions: Lists the breaking change (removal of /v1/reports) first, with what users must do (use /v2/reports)
Leaves out the internal commits (eslint bump, CI cache, InvoiceRepository refactor, export tests)
Includes CSV export, the upload-session fix and the VAT-number fix in plain language

evals.prompt: Release notes for this one please (git-log-internal.txt).
evals.expected_output: Says there are no user-facing changes rather than dressing up internal commits.
assertions: States there are no user-facing changes in this release (or a one-line 'maintenance release' note)
Does not present the dependency bump, CI, refactor or test commits as user features or fixes

evals.prompt: Turn git-log-jargon.txt into release notes for our customers.
evals.expected_output: Plain-language user impact; no internal identifiers.
assertions: Describes the sync fix and the faster invoice grid in plain user terms (what the user notices)
Drops internal identifiers: no SyncWorker.retryLoop, useOptimisticRows, ETag 412, IDB or JIRA ids
